meta.title: Open themes · ONIR CMS
meta.description: Download the ONIR CMS visual templates: Immersive, Starter, MandamPro, Nuit & Jade and Atelier Paper. Open, ready to import.
meta.ogDescription: Download the ONIR CMS visual templates.

hero.title: Open themes.
hero.lead: Visual templates ready to import into ONIR CMS. Download them from the project.

items.name: Immersive
items.description: A complete 3D scene: entrance house, room, avatar, album, guided conversation and attachment import.
items.detailsText: Official template with CC0 assets included. 3D scene, TalkingHead avatar, album, knowledge, media, link settings and attachments (CV, documents).
items.author: Rinoheinrich

items.name: Starter
items.description: The reference template: identification form, conversation and media.
items.detailsText: The minimal starting point to understand the host contract and build your own visual template.
items.author: Rinoheinrich

items.name: MandamPro
items.description: A public conversation inspired by ChatGPT: form, messages, fiche search and media.
items.detailsText: MandamPro public template, UI-only, rendering search blocks, media and typed fields.
items.author: Rinoheinrich

items.name: Nuit & Jade
items.author: Anjary
items.description: An elegant conversation in midnight blue, jade and cobalt: rounded cards, avatar and page + widget surfaces.
items.detailsText: ONIR CMS template created by Anjary. Man-Dam Pro styling: midnight blue, jade and cobalt, white cards, pill buttons, avatar and generic rendering of messages, media and search results.

items.name: Atelier Paper
items.author: Anjary
items.description: A black-and-white paper template with notched cards and monospace type, for a sober editorial conversation.
items.detailsText: ONIR CMS template created by Anjary. “Spin Product” design: white notched cards, black accent, monospace type, page and widget surfaces.

steps.title: Attach
steps.text: Attach the template to the assistant.
